note: Rewritten from the description of the new species N. parviscutatus in Light 1930, Philippine Termites, IV; the fragment begins in the later part of the alate description, so the earlier description of the adult head, wings and the like, and the diagnosis, are not included. The soldier body length reads "8-00" in the OCR of the original and is reproduced as it stands. The nymphal-antenna phrase "shorter than long" is thus in the original and has not been changed.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Sides of the pronotum convex, the posterolateral angles deeply recessed and meeting a posterior margin that is almost straight, slightly concave near the middle and without a notch; the two ends of the pronotum appear bent forward at the outer quarter; apart from the above characters and those given in the diagnosis, similar to N. malatensis (the fragment begins in the middle of this paragraph, the preceding text being lost). Measurements (mm, king / queen): body length 11.0 / 12.0; head length (total) 2.34 / 2.34; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 1.82 / 1.82; head width 2.16 / 2.16; eye diameter 0.64 / 0.64; ocellus diameter 0.27 / 0.27; pronotum width (in situ) 2.34 / 2.34; pronotum length (in situ) 1.24 / 1.24.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head arched, enlarged posteriorly, narrowed anteriorly, sides convex; sutures distinct; dorsal margin of the antennal sockets projecting and upturned. Mandibles scarcely curved upward; left mandible with 2 teeth close together near the tip; right mandible with 2 widely separated teeth, the more distal of which is opposite the more proximal tooth of the left mandible; left mandible more incurved than the right, its base distinctly swollen. Eyes reduced to a narrow, elongate, vertical translucent patch. Pronotum very short, much narrower than the head, anterior margin broadly concave and posterior margin convex; sides strongly convex, passing smoothly into the anterior and posterior margins; mesonotum and metanotum much narrower than the pronotum. Measurements (mm): body length 8-00; head length (with mandibles) 3.55; head length (without mandibles) 2.16; head width 1.93; pronotum length 0.63; pronotum width 1.62.

sections.label: Nymph
sections.text: Small, the largest less than 6 mm; no trace of wing buds; head pale yellow, body almost white-yellow; back of head rounded, sides roughly parallel, slightly swollen below the antennae; antennae 12 or 13-segmented (11 in very young individuals), segment I the largest, segment II larger than segments III to VII, segment III small but larger than IV and V; segment IV very small, discoidal, often indistinctly delimited from III; segment V two to three times as long as IV but shorter than long (thus in the original); segment VI about as long as wide; segments VII to the penultimate gradually increasing in size; terminal segment smaller and narrow. Eye pigment pale. Pronotum small, shaped as in the soldier. Body as in the soldier. Cerci distinct, styles long and slender. Measurements (mm): body length 6.0; head width 1.42; head length 1.62; head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 1.40; pronotum width (in situ) 1.20; pronotum length 0.45.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: mountains behind Dumaguete, Occidental Negros, Negros Island; numbers 564 and 567; collected by J. W. Chapman and S. F. Light on 9 May 1921 (month 5); from a tree stump, the rest of which had yielded colonies of Glyptotermes and Heterotermes.
